tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dgyes pa rdo rje'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na mo shrī he badzra yā/ gang zhig zag med mnyes kyang zag pa can la rjes chags mdzad// thugs rje che mnga' rgyal ba mchog gis rims bzhin dbang bskur zhing*// rdo rje'i tshig don mngon du mdzad pas rim gnyis mthar phyin pa// bla ma dam pa rin chen zhabs pad gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lus kyi 'ching ba gcod byed gzugs sku'i 'bras 'byin pa// dgyes pa'i rdo rje dpal ldan bsgrub thabs gsal bar bya// dang por re shig bsgrub pa po// dbang thob dam tshig sdom ldan pas// gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sar// bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas te// khrag 'thung dpal gyi nga rgyal gyi// tha mal lus kyi mngon zhen bzlog /kha lag bdud rtsi'i ri lus sbyang*// yid dang ngag kyang rab dag nas// rang gi snying khar re pa bsgom// de las byung ba'i nyi dkyil 'khor// der ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa nyid// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin no// 'od 'phros nam mkhar rje btsun ni// bla ma dang bcas dkyil 'khor bsam// rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi// lha mo brgyad po spros la mchod// ri khrod mas ni ro sna tshogs// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// reg bya gzugs dang dri sna tshogs// nam mkha'i khams khyab rnam par spro// dkar mos ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom kun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni dri chu'i bdag /gha sma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*// pu ka si ni dbus gnas bcud// 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtso bo mchod// bde ba chen po rjes chags pas// g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa nyid// de ltar bla ma sangs rgyas mchod// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid la bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyi ste// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can mgron kun gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/dang po byams pa bsgom par bya// gnyis pa snying rje bsgom bya zhing*// gsum par dga' ba bsgom pa dang*// kun gyi mtha' mar btang snyoms so// yang ni stong pa'i byang chub ste// mchod bya mchod byed bsdus te bsgom// oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badzra na badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐// skye ba med pa'i sbyor ba yis// skye ba 'dir ni rab grags te// dpa' bos bden brdzun rnam spyad pas// brtags pas nye bar brtag mi bya// re pas nyi ma rnams bsgoms nas// hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste// rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi ste// mtshams bcing pa yang rnam par bsgom// oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐// 'jig dus lta bu'i me dpung gis// phyogs bcur bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsreg /de ma thag par rdo rje'i dbus// chos 'byung kha dog sna tshogs pa// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par// sna tshogs rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom// yam̐ las g.yo ba sngon po'i dbus// ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar// bam̐ las chu yi dkyil 'khor dkar// lam̐ las dbang chen gser gyi mdog /bhrum̐ las 'khor lo dkar po ste// bdag gi rnam shes na da las// 'od zer thigs pa rab 'phros te// zhu ba las ni gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi yang dag 'bar ba nyid// sgo bzhi gzi brjid chen po ste// re ga lnga dang yang dag ldan// ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan// rdo rje srad bus rnam par spras// do shal do shal phyed pas 'phyang*// phreng ba sna tshogs rnga yab ldan// phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor// sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag 'khrugs// lte bar pad ma 'dab brgyad dbus// bdud bzhi'i ro ni gnas pa ste// shar lho nub byang mtshams rnams su// tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang*// bden bral dang ni thag bzang ris// gho ri ma la sogs pa'i gdan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ni la ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/

de nas a li ka li las// zla ba me long ye shes te// bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan// sa bon nang du son gyur pa// de nyid so sor rtog par brjod// hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje ni// kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po// spro bsdu don byas zhu ba las// bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid// rdzogs pa chos dbyings rang bzhin du// zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom// rdo rje skye ba nag po che// 'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba'i mdog /yang na sngo dang nyi ma'i mdog /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa// zhabs bzhi pa la 'jigs pa po// bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud// dga' ba gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pa'i// mkha' dbyings pam̐ dang am̐ las ni// rdo rje chus skyes mdzes pa yi// rjes su mthun par bskyed par bya// oṃ badzra ma hā dhe sha tsa tu ra nan ta ya ka kha kha mu khā ka ra so na tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka tyam̐ ku ru sha me/ oṃ pad ma su kham̐ dha ra ma hā ra khā su kham̐ dha ra tsa tu ra a nan ta bi ka sa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka ryam̐ ku ru sha me/ de ltar lan gcig mnyam sbyor bas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun bsdus nas// rba rlabs med pa'i bde ba thob// rlom sems med pa'i rang bzhin can// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/ grong khyer nyams dgar rol pa las// thig le las byung yi ge ni// gham̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gam̐ /pam̐ ṣam̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ 'di yi sa bon phyung ba dang*// bdag med bha ga'i dkyil 'khor nas// gham̐ las byung ba'i gho ri ni// nag mo g.yas na gri gug ste// de bzhin g.yon na ro hi ta// shar gyi sgo ru phyung nas gnas/ bsrub dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las// tsam̐ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma'i// btsod kyi kha dog g.yas cang te'u// g.yon pa'i phyag na phag pa nyid// phyung nas lho yi sgo phyogs su// bho la ka kko la sbyor bas// bam̐ las byung ba'i ro langs ma// gser mdog g.yas na ru sbal te// g.yon pa pad ma'i snod 'dzin pa// phyung nas nub kyi sgo ru ni// bdud 'joms ma ni rnam par gnas// dga' ba chen po'i snyoms 'jug las// gham̐ las byung ba'i gha sma ri// mar gad mdog can g.yas na sbrul// g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed nyid// 'dzin pa phyung nas byang gi sgor// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas// de bzhin pam̐ las pu ka si// dbang sngon mdog can g.yas seng ge

/g.yon pa dgra sta 'dzin pa nyid// drag gzugs ma ni dbang ldan mtshams// yang ni ṣam̐ las ri khrod ma// zla ba'i 'od can g.yas dge slong*// g.yon pa bsil byed 'dzin pa ni// 'tshed pa'i mtshams su legs par dgod// de bzhin lam̐ las gdol pa mo// sngo bsangs g.yas na 'khor lo ste// g.yon pas tho ba de bzhin no// srin po'i mtshams su rnam par gnas// de ltar ḍam̐ las g.yung mo ni// sna tshogs mdog can rdo rje g.yas// g.yon pa yis ni sdig mdzub mdzad// rlung gi mtshams su bkod nas ni// thams cad dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar// sna tshogs brgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes// ma mo'i dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs nas// de nas rdo rje chags chen la// na da nye bar zhugs gyur pas// rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur// de tshe tshad med bzhi ldan pa'i// sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa las// myur bar lha mo rnams kyis bskul// rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pu ka si ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen 'dod par sbyor// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// dgyes pa rdo rje khyod bzhengs cig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam cing*// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /de nas oṃ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang*// khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni// zhabs rnams sa la rdebs pa dang*// lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzad// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni// tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang*// brgya byin la sogs bdud bzhi mnan// rnam thar brgyad kyi zhal rnams ni// rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che// g.yas pa na ni kun da mtshungs// g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa// spyi bo'i zhal ni gtsigs pa can// lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin// spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis che// bcu drug rang bzhin stong nyid phyag

/glang po rta bong glang rnga mo// mi dang sha ra bha byi la// nad rnams sel bar mdzad pa'i phyir// g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na 'dzin// sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ me dang zla ba nyi ma nyid// mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin dag /dbang phyug yon tan rtsol ba'i phyir// g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o// mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal mdzad// kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po// sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin// nyid kyi zhal nas hūm̐ spro zhing*// thal bas lus la byugs pa dang*// 'khor lo rna cha nor bu dang*// lag gdub dang ni ska rags nyid// phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'o// sgeg pa dpa' bo mi sdug pa// rgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung pa// snying rje rngam zhing zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// bdag med ma ni mdun bzhugs te// zhal gcig ma la phyag gnyis ma// g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod khrag /sku mdog nag cing cher 'bar ma// drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// gho ri la sogs lha mo kun// snga ma bzhin du gsal bar bsgom// sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dag par// rdzogs nas yan lag rnam par bsgom// mig la gti mug rdo rje ma// mam̐ las byung ba'i kha dog nag /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sa bon dham̐ las kha dog dmar// sna la ser sna rdo rje ma// aṃ las skyes pa kha dog ser// lce la 'dod chags rdo rje ma// yi ge ram̐ las kha dog ljang*// reg la phrag dog rdo rje ma// saṃ las dbang po sngon po'i mdog /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// nam̐ yig las byung bcom ldan mdog /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// gri thod phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// spyi bor oṃ las skyes pa yis// sku yi rdo rje zla ba'i mdog /mgrin par aḥlas gsung rdo rje// dmar po nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal/ snying khar hūm̐ yig las byung pa// thugs kyi rdo rje nam mkha'i mdog /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// rang rig yum gyis sku la 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o// thugs kyi rdo rje'i thugs ka ru// rtse lnga hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la// 'od zer dra ba 'phro ba bsgom// de las 'od 'phros spro bsdu yis// bcom ldan dkyil 'khor rab tu gzhug

/oṃ gho'u ri a ghu sha dza/ tso'u ri pa sha hūm̐/ be ta li po ta bam̐/ gha sma ri ghan dha ho/ rnam pa bzhi ni rdzogs pa dang*// de ma thag tu lha dbang bskur// nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa'i 'od// sa bon las byung lcags kyu'i dbyibs// phyung nas sangs rgyas kun bkug ste// ma mo rnams kyis yang dag mchod// oṃ badzra puṣpe a hūm̐ swāhā/ badzra dhu pe/ badzra dhi pe/ badzra ghan dhe/ badzra ne pe te/ a hūm̐ sarba pan tsa armi ta pu tsa a hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐/ de ma thag tu sangs rgyas kun// he ru ka yi gzugs kyis ni// rin chen bum pas dbang bskur bsam// dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// gnyis med sbyor ba'i me tog char// ngag gi lam du 'bab par 'gyur// lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba yis// gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs kyis mchod// spyan sogs dga' ba'i glu yis ni// rdzogs pas rigs kyi bdag por 'gyur// rdor sems mi bskyod rnam snang mdzad// rin chen dpag med go rims bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐// de nas dam tshig rdzas sbyar ba/ yang na yid kyi sbyor ba yis// yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me// thod pa'i steng du a las snod/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan// gho ku dha ha na/ bhi mu ma ra shu/ hūm̐ bhrum̐ dziṃ ām̐ kham̐/ steng du rdo rje zla ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa las// 'od 'phros sbyangs sbar bdud rtsir gyur// rdo rje'i lce yis myang bar bya// 'phro ba'i sbyor bas tshim par bya// oṃ sarba tha ga ta armi? ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐// de ma thag par lha mo rnams// snga ma lta bur rab 'phros te// nam mkha'i khams rnams kun bkang nas// mchod sprin dkyil 'khor rab tu mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa badzra swa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis// mngon par bstod pa du ma bsam// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor// nyid ni khyod kyi thugs kyis don rnams 'grub// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro kun don bsgrub khyod// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bsgrub mdzad pa// dgyes pa'i rdo rje he ru la bstod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga stu ti ra badzra swa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐/

spros la dga' bar gyur pa yis// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni// du mas mchod dang bstod pa bya// de ltar yan lag drug rdzogs nas// skyo na rnam par dag pa bsgom// snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi yin no// bdud dag pas kyang zhabs rnams bzhi/ rdo rje gsum gyis dag pa'i spyan// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug bskyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ dbang po drug ni sems dpa' drug /sha ni pu ka si yin la// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu nyid// lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// de nas gzhan yang brjod pa ni// gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// tshor ba la ni dkar mor bshad// 'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni// bdag med rnal 'byor mar gnas so// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma ri rab grags// reg la sa spyod ma zhes bshad// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// sa ni pu ka si zhes bshad// chu khams rngon pa mo zhes brjod// me ni gtum mor shes par bya// rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags// zhe sdang zhes brjod bdag med ma// 'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma// phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mor bshad// gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// lha mo rnams kyi dag pa'o// de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ thugs kha'i sa bon la 'od zer las kyi bye brag dang mthun pa'i kha dog can spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba'am/ mda'i shugs lta bu gang yang rung ste/

ci srid mi skyo'i bar ram/ mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar du bzlas so// oṃ aṣṭa na na ya/ ping kāau/ dha ke sha war ta ma na/ tsa tur bi sha ti nai tra ya/ sho ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ kriṣṇa dzi mu ta wa pu she ka pa la mā la/ a ṇe dha ri ni/ a dha ma ta kru ra tsi ta yā/ a dhen dhu daṃṣṇi ni/ oṃ ma ra ya ma ra ya/ ka ra ya ka ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ ta rdza ya ta rdza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ a ta paṃ ka ra na/ bhan dha bhan dha/ na ka aṣṭa ka na/ ghṛ hna ghri nha/ sha trum̐ na/ ha hā hi hī hu hū/ he hāe ho hāau/ haṃ hā hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ de ba pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ri rī*/ li lī/ e āe/ o āau/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yul dang rnal 'byor ma bco lnga'i sngags so// oṃ a go ri ghaṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ tso ri tsaṃ/ bhe ta li baṃ/ gha sma ru ghaṃ/ pu ka si pam̐/ sha bha ri ṣaṃ/ tsan dha li laṃ/ ḍaṃ bhi ni ḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ spyi'am bye brag gi rim pa shes par bya'o// gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod pas/ brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom// spros pa rmi lam 'dra byas nas// spros pa nyid ni spros med bya// nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa yi// 'od zer spros nas bsdu bya ste// zhal du lha mo rnams bsdu nas// zhu ba las ni lhan cig skyes// gong bu na da'i gzugs kyis kyang*// dmigs pa las 'das phyag rgya che// spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu// de bzhin nyid don mngon du bya// yang na bcom ldan rang bzhin gyi// lte bar gtum mo spa ra bya ste// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs nas/ bsregs pas ri bong can ham̐ 'dzag /zhu ba'i lhan cig skyes pa la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyas btab ste/ du ba la sogs mtshan ma dag /mthong bar ma gyur bar du bsgom// thun mtshams lha'i tshogs rnams la// ci skad bshad pa'i gtor ma yis// cho ga bzhin du tshim par bya// des ni bar chad zhi bar 'gyur// thun mtshams lha'i nga rgyal gyis// spyod lam rnal 'byor thams cad bya// rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor ba yis// myur du dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/

de ltar rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub phyir 'bad pa yis// dgyes pa'i rdo rje he ru ka dpal bsgrub thabs 'dir// byas las dge ba dri med zla ltar gsal gyur pas// ye shes ku mu ta yi tshal rab rgyas gyur cig dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'di ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dang bla ma dam pa mchog gi dgongs pa ci lta bar/ rab tu gsal zhing go bde ba'i ngag tu/ rang byung rdo rje zhes bya bas mtshur phu'i dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// mtshams sbyor mang po dor byas te// tshig nyung shin tu gsal ba de// gangs can khrod 'dir 'dod min kyang*// rgyud dang mi 'gal spyi bos long*// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog// / ༈ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs tshig lhug ma bzhugs so// dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bsgrub pa po dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ gnas dben par bstan bde ba la 'dug te/ bdud rtsi ri lu dang sbyar ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyis kha dag par bya zhing*/ gnas khang la'ang gtor nas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o// de nas he badzra zhes brjod pas skad cig gis dgyes pa'i rdo rjer bsgoms pa'i snying khar/ hrī las pad ma 'dab brgyad pa dmar po/ dbus su ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsgoms nas/ de'i 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa shar 'khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te/ thal mo sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ gho ri gham̐ a hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gho ri ma nag mo bdud rtsi byang sems kyi snod thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ de zin pa'i brdar se gol gcig btog de bzhin du/ oṃ tso'u ri tsaṃ a hūm̐/ oṃ bhe dha li bhaṃ a hūṃ swa hūm̐ swāhā/

oṃ gha sma ri gha a hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pu ka si pam̐ a hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ sha ba ri shaṃ a hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsan dha li tsaṃ a hūm̐ swā hā*/ oṃ dhoṃ bi ni dham̐ a hūm̐ swā hā/ lha mo de rnams sku mdog dmar mo/ ser/ ljang/ sngo/ dkar/ sngo sangs/ khra mo rnams kyis pad ma rag ta dang*/ dri chu dang*/ dri chen dang*/ sha sna tshogs dang*/ chang dang cang te'u dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi mchod pas mchod do// de nas sdig pa bshags shing sdom pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ lam brtan pa dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba rnams bsgoms te/ de nas tshig gi gsal gdab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid la gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyi ste// bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /he badzra ma dha la mu zhes pas rten de rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba de yang rgyun du brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ dgra gnyen med pa'i gtang snyoms bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud la bsdus/ de rang gi lus la bsdus/ de yang snying pad ma 'dab brgyad la thim/ de nyi ma la thim/ de hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la/ de zla tshes thig le thim pas na da'i rnam pa lta bur bsgom la/

oṃ shu n+ya ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ na da las rang sgra byung bar bsams la brjod/ de nas ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse mo las rdo rje rgya gram dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ de nas gzhi ma'i nyi ma las 'od zer 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi ma'i rdo rje rgya gram las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i dra dmigs bkag par bsam la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas brtan par bsgom/ de'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba'i phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs mche ba gyen la bstan pa cig bsgom/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng tu chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam pa cig bsgom/ 'byung ba bzhi'i steng du bhrum̐ las tsakra rtsibs sum cu so gnyis pa'i dbus su na da cig zhu bar bsgom*/ de rnams 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba cig bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a ni la ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐ zhes pas rgyas gdab ste/ pho brang rnam par dag pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag go /de nas gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su bdud bzhi'i rang bzhin/ tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang*/ drag po bzhi/ shar du tshangs pa/ lhor dbang po/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar gshin rje/ shar lhor nor bdag lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris rnams gan rgyal du bsam/

dbus kyi padma la gnas pa'i bdud rmas kyi steng du/ a ā i ī u ū ri rī li lī e āai o āau aṃ las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i rang bzhin no// de'i steng du aṃ hūm̐ sngon po gnas pas so sor rtogs pa'i rang bzhin no// de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍha ḍa ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus pa las/ thod pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug as mtshan par gyur te/ thams cad zhu zhing cig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyis rang bzhin/ de gyur pa las/ rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang sku mdog nag po bdag med ma dang bcas pa/ zhal brgyad/ zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ khro bo'i chas dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'o// de nas yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas stong par bsam/ de'i ngang nas hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po bskyed la/ oṃ dkar po las nor bu rjes su mthun pa'i sbu gu can du bskyed la/ oṃ badzra mahā dhe sha tsa tu ra a nan ta ya ka kha mu ke ka ra so na tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ karya ku ru sha me zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa'o// yum gyi gsang gnas stong pa'i ngang las baṃ dmar po las pad ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bskyed la a dmar po las ze 'bru rjes su mthun pa'i sbu gu can du bskyed la/ oṃ pad ma su kha dha ra ma ha ra kha na tsa tu ra a nan ta bha ki ba sho hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar yang ku ru sha me*/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs te/ bsrub pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas yab yum thabs shes rab gnyis su med pas snyoms par zhugs pas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu si dang phaṭa kyi sgras/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bskul nas/ zhal du zhugs thugs khar zhu/ rtsa dbu ma nas song rdo rje'i lam nas byung yum gyi mkha' khams su babs/

yab yum gnyis dang sangs rgyas thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ro yis tshim par bsam mo// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a nu ra ga ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ rjes su chags pa rdo rje 'chang gi yan lag go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mkha' nas/ ghaṃ tsaṃ baṃ gam̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ rnams yum gyi mkhar spros te/ rnal 'byor ma rnams su gyur zhing phyogs mtshams su spro ba ni/ shar gyi 'dab mar gho ri mdog nag mo g.yas na gri gug g.yon na ro hi ta'i nya bsnams pa'o// lho tso'u ri dmar mo phyag g.yas na rnge'u chung*/ g.yon na phag pa bsnams pa'o// nub tu ro langs ma dmar ser g.yas na ru sbal g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o// byang du gha sma ri ljang khu phyag g.yas na sbrul/ g.yon na thod pa/ byang shar du pu ka si sngon mo/ g.yas pa seng ge g.yon dgra sta bsnams pa'o// shar lho mtshams su sha ba ri dkar mo/ phyag g.yas na dge slong g.yon na bsil byed bsnams pa'o// lho nub kyi mtshams su tsan dha li sngon mo/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo 'dzin pa g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa/ nub byang gi mtshams su ḍoṃ bi ni sna tshogs kyi mdog can/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon pa sdig mdzub mdzad pa bsgoms par bya'o// lha mo brgyad po de dag kyang spyan gsum pa zhal cig pa phyag gnyis pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bsgreng la/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa phye dkrung dang bcas pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o// de rnams ni rgyu'i he ru ka 'khor rnal 'byor ma brgyad dang bcas pa bskyed do// de nas nam mkha'i na da skar mda' 'phos pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs nas/ yum gyi pad mar bab pas yum bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ yum zhu bas yab kyang bde ba'i rang bzhin du zhu nas/ dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur bsgoms mo// de nas mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/

dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms tshad med pa'i glus bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pu ka si ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor zhes mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// dgyes pa'i rdo rje khyed bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyed kyi thugs 'tshal gyis// mi 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /zhes shin tu snyan pa'i glus bskul lo// de nas byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin a hūm̐ gis rang bzhin du gyur zhing 'od zer 'phros 'dus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad pa phyag bcu drug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga yi phreng ba brgyan pa/ de'i steng du thod pa gsum gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna ba la rna cha/ mgul pa la mgul brgyan/ lag pa la lag gdub/ sked pa ska rags te 'og phag gi /de ltar phyag brgya drug dang ldan pa'o// rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po// g.yas kyi dkar po/ g.yon gyi dmar po/ yang g.yon gyi zhal gnyis sngo ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis kyang sngo ba/ steng gi zhal du ba'i kha dog sngo skya/ zhal de dag thams cad kyang mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum pa'o// g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa'i glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ bong bu dang*/ glang dang*/ rnga mong dang*/ mi dang*/ sha ra ba dang*/ byi la'o// de bzhin du g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ chu'i lha mo dang*/ me'i lha mo dang*/ rlung lha dang*/

zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ nor sbyin no/ sku la mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ gnyis dkyil krung phyed pa'i bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnan pa/ gar gyi ro dgu dang ldan pa'o// yum bdag med ma sngon mo phyag g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ thod pa lnga'i phreng bas mgo bor brgyan pa/ sku la skyes pa'i mgo bo skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa bsgom par bya'o// skabs 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang gsal gdab bo// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba tshon gang ba cig bsgom/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje nas tsam de'i lte ba la sran chung bshags pa'i ga'u tsam pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po spus bris pa tsam cig bsgom/ yum gyi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa cig bsgom de nas skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dhaṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la aṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog ro ma ljang gu/ snying khar a las bdag med ma sngon mo/ de rnams thams cad zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon na thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭwām̐ ga bcug pa dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro yi steng na bzhugs pa'o// de nas spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po/ mgrin par a las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po// thugs khar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sku mdog sngon po thams cad zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/

rdo rje dril bu can bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhu tsa ri badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta la wa si ni badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes pas rgyas gdab bo// de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te/ ye shes kyi maṇḍal mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab nas 'bul zhing*/ oṃ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho khaṃ raṃ a hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon 'bul/ oṃ ni si ti hūm̐ khaṃ a hūm̐/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ ghan dhe/ ne pe te/ shapta a hūṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod la oṃ badzra go ri a kar ṣa ya dza zhes pas dam tshig sems pa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug oṃ badzra tso ri pra pe sha ya hūm̐ zhes pas gzhug oṃ badzra bhe ta li ban dha bam̐ zhes pas bcing*/ oṃ badzra ghas ma ri pa sham̐ ku ru ho zhes pas mi dgyes pa med par dgyes par bsam pa ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bzhugs pa'o// de nas rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i bhudha thams cad spyan drangs la/ gong bzhin du gho ri la sogs pa brgyad kyis mchod nas/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig zhes gsol ba btab pas bhu dha de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bar bsgom/ de'i dus na me tog gi char dbab pa dang*/ rnga'i sgra bsgrags pa dang*/ gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang*/ gzugs rdo rje la sogs pas mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pas len par bsgom/ lus thams cad byang sems kyi chu rgyun gyis khengs par bsam/ bag chags kyi dri ma dag pa bsam/ chu cung zad yar 'khyil bas/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ pu ka si dang gho ri ma la mi bskyod pa/

sha ba ri dang tso'u ri ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsan dha li dang be ta li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ dho bi ni dang*/ ghas ma ri la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsgom/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a be ṣe ka ta badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go /de nas bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ gtor ma'am dam tshig gi rdzas la yaṃ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba cig bskyed/ gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsam mo// phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog a/ steng zla phyed rdo rje/ rtse mo la hūm̐ mgo thur du blta ba cig bsam/ de nas rlung gis me sbar/ thod pa dros pas sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang a las 'od zer 'phros te/ zla ba rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ de gnyis 'dres pa las/ oṃ ā hūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang der zhu/ de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo la rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa bsgoms la/ rdo rje'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi gsol bas shin tu mnyes par bsgom/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a mri ta a sa ta dang badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes rgyas gdab ste/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /de nas bdag gi thugs kha nas 'od zer spros pa 'jig rten na gzugs sdug pa dang*/ sgra snyan pa la sogs pa 'od zer gyis bsdus nas/ lha rnams la pu tsa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa sprul la de rnams kyis bdag lha dgur bsgoms pa la mchod par bsams te/ dngos su bdag nyid kyis phyi dang*/ nang gsang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi pu tsa rnams kyis gong bzhin du mchod do// oṃ sarba ta thā ga pu tsa badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes rgyas gdab bo// mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag go /de nas lha mo rnams kyis bdag la bstod par bsams te// khyod kyi rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yongs su bskor/

khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyed dgongs 'grub// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'khor ba kun bsgrub khyod// snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bsgrub mdzad pa'i// dgyes pa'i rdo rje he ru ka la bstod// zhes bya ba'am/ pa ra ka la sogs pas bstod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tod ta ri badzra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes rgyas gdab bo// bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag drug ldan du ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgoms nas/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags kyi phreng ba/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi mkha' nas zhal du byung zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas thugs khar brgyud pa'am/ 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa gang yang rung bas bzlas te/ oṃ ashta na na ya/ ping ka lāau dha ke sha wa dha ma ne/ tsa tur bing sha ti ne tra ya/ sho ṭa sha bhu dza ya ghris sna dzi mu ta/ wa pu she/ ka pa la ma la a ne kaṃ dha ri ni a dha ma ta kru ra tsitta ya/ ar dhen dhu dhaṃ ྴྟི ne oṃ ma ra yā/ ma ra ya*/ ka ra yā ka ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sam̐ gha te sa ka ra na/ bhan dha bhan dha/ na ga aṣṭa ka na/ ghri hna ghri hna/ sha trun/ ha ha hi hi hu hu he he ho ho ham̐ ha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ oṃ dhe ba pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ badzra ka ta ri he badzra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ a swā hā/ yum gyi'o// oṃ a go ri ghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā// oṃ a tso ri tsaṃ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a bhe ta li baṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a gha sma ri ghaṃ? hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ a pu ka si bam̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a sha ba ri shaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a tsan dha li tsaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/

oṃ a ḍoṃ bhi ni dhoṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes ci rigs pas bzlas so// skyo na rnam par dag pa dran par bya ste/ thugs byams pa mi 'gyur ba'i phyir sku mdog nag po'o// snying rjes sems can la chags pa'i phyir spyan dmar ba/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi zhal can/ rdo rje gsum dag pa'i spyan stong pa nyid bcu drug gi phyag// lpags pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ rus pa ni bden pa bzhi/ zhabs ni bdud bzhi dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag pa/ sha ni pu ka si/ khrag ni ri khrod ma/ khu ba ni gdol pa mo/ rkang dang tshil bu ni g.yung mo/ de bzhin du phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams ni/ lha mo rnams rnam par dag pa'o zhes mnyam par bzhag go /de yang rnam par shes pa dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dag pa bdag med ma'o// gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ gti mug dag pa rdo rje ma'o// tshor ba dang ser sna dag pa dkar mo'o// 'du shes dang 'dod chags dag pa chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ 'du byed dang phrag dog dag pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'o// sa dag pa pu ka si/ chu dag pa rngon pa mo'o/ me dag pa gtum mo/ rlung dag pa g.yung mo/ gzugs dag pa dkar mo/ sgra dag pa tso ri ma/ dri dag pa ro langs ma/ ro dag pa ghas ma ri/ reg dag pa sa spyod ma/ chos dag pa mkha' spyod ma'o// de nas thun bsdu ba ni/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas kyi khang la bsdus te/ de yang lha mo brgyad la/ de rnams zhal du bsdu/ yab yum gyi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang hūm̐ la hūm̐ yang thig le dang na da'i rang bzhin du bsdus te/ chos thams cad 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin du bsgoms par bya'o// thun mtshams ni zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i spyod lam gyis bya ba thams cad bsgrub par bya'o// mthun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas bdag gi de kho na nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa sngar ltar bsgom pa'am/

gzhan du zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ mgron gyi de kho na nyid ni/ e las chos 'byung dkar la dmar ba'i dbus su steng du pad ma dkar po/ bar du sngon po/ 'og tu dmar po/ 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam ste/ bdag gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha spros te sa bla sa 'og sa stengs kyi 'gro ba thams cad la phog tshur bsdus/ steng du oṃ dkar po/ dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ 'og tu a dmar po/ dgu dgur gyur par bsams te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ steng ma la sku rdo rje lha chen po brgyad dang bcas pa dkar po/ bar ma la thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa mthing kha/ 'og ma la gsung rdo rje klu chen po brgyad dang bcas pa dmar po'i mdog can thams cad kyang zhal cig phyag gnyis yum dang bcas pa rdo rje dang dril bu can du bsgoms la/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa ā/ snying khar hūṃ bkod la gho'u ri a ghu sha dza/ tso'u ri pa sha hūm̐/ be ta li po ta bam̐/ ghas ma ri ghan dha ho/ zhes dgug gzhug bcing ba byas nas/ thams cad kyi lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga par byin gyis brlab bo// gtor ma'i de kho na nyid ni/ yam̐ las rlung*/ raṃ las me kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyid po gsum/ a las snod ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du gho'u ku dha ha na las sha lnga/ bi mo ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ hūm̐ bhrum̐ dziṃ oṃ khaṃ lnga las ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ ā hūm̐ las rdo rje zla ba dang kha chod dang bcas par bsams te/ me rlung 'bar zhing rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor bas zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste gnyis su med par gyur pa 'phro ba'i sbyor bas tshim par bsgoms te/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams kyang spros shing mchod la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das la yang mchod pas mnyes par bsams te/ mgron spyi la 'bul ba'i sngags ni/

oṃ in dha/ dza ma/ dza la/ dza kṣa/ bhu ta/ bha ni/ ba yu/ rakṣa/ tsan dha/ pu dza/ ma ta/ pa ta/ ta la sa ta la/ a ta sa bhya swā hā/ i daṃ bha ling*/ bhu dza/ dzī ga phu la/ dhu pa/ mam̐ sa/ bhiṃ ga adma/ sappa/ kadzdza/ sa ta/ khan ni/ khu ni/ pheḍa ṭa/ ga ta/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ/ adye nud pan nad da tya/ oṃ a hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod de phul bas gsol zhing shin tu mnyes par bsgom zhing*/ bstod pa byas te/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod dang*/ dgra'i sde rnam par 'joms pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol zhes brjod la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ smon lam ni/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// mnyam med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma las gus snying rje ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos rnams klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /zhes brjod la badzra mu yis gshegs su gsol lo// gtor ma'i cho ga'o// mngon rtogs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni/ bla ma mar pa'i mdo dang sbyar ba ci lta ba bzhin du/ rang byung rdo rje yis mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// rgyud ci lta ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni kho bos sngar byas zin to// shes rab dang ldan pa rnams de nyid la blta' bar bya'o// shin du rgyas pa ni bla ma mar pa nyid kyi mdo sbyar dang*/ me rngog dang*/ mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rnams na yod pas de rnams su ltos shig 'di sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyis/ sems can thams cad he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig// / ༈ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lus dkyil bzhugs so// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas/

rang dam tshig sems dpar bsgom pa la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bstim pa'i mthus/ rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du cig char gyur par dmigs nas/ rims gsal gdab par bya ste/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs logs rdo rje'i ra ba lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bres/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba ste/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o// rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab stod kyi cha lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu bas sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa ra ga'i brtsigs pa/ sna rin chen pha gu so dra ba dra phyed/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad de/ gzhal yas khang pa'o// snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la hūṃ las rnam par shes pa'i phung po dag pas mi bskyod par gyur pa/ sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis yum chu dag pa ma ma ki sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ las tshor ba dag pa rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur pa sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis yum sa dag pa rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yum 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo'o// spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar/ haṃ las gzugs dag pa rnam par snang mdzad du gyur pa/

sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang*/ dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis/ yum nam mkha' dag pa nam mkha' chos kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'o/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar/ oṃ las 'du shes dag pa 'od dpag med du gyur pa sku mdog dmar po/ pad ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis/ yum me dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'o// gsang gnas bde chen kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar ha las 'du byed dag pa don yod grub par gyur pa sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis/ yum rlung dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'o// gtso bo lnga po ni/ dbu'i gtsug gtor ltar mi mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang ldan pa'o// de dag ni pho brang lngas bsdus pa'i lha brgya lnga cu nga bdun gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// gzhan yang mig gti mug rdo rje nas/ yid bdag med ma'i bar nang gi skye mched dag pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum la rdo rje ma gsum dang*/ mig la sogs pa phyi'i cha la brten pa'i mig tu gzugs/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo me long 'dzin pa/ rna bar sgra/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo pi wang 'dzin pa/ snar dri/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ lcer ro/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo zhal zas kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/

dpral par reg bya/ reg rdo rje ma ljang khu na bza' 'dzin pa/ snying khar chos kyi khams chos kyi dbyings phyug ma sngon mo/ chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dzin pa bsgom mo// lag pa g.yas pa gshin rje gshed/ g.yon pa shes rab mthar byed/ kha pad ma mthar byed/ gsang gnas bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas pa mi g.yo ba/ g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ rje ngar g.yas pa dbyug sngon can/ g.yon pa stobs po che/ spyi gtsug 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnod mdzes rgyal po'o// lha'i sku de dag thams cad kyi sku'i dbyings rnam pa bde ba rang bzhin gsal ba'o// ngo bo zung 'jug tu mos par bya'o// gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yig rdzogs pa'i sku/ snying po ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi skur bsgoms te cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /lus dkyil bsdus pa rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /lus dkyil gyi lha rnams la/ dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan pa ni/ gtso bo lnga po la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang skye mched kyi lha rnams la rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rigs bdag dang*/ khro bo bcu la bsrung 'khor gyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bsam mo// ༈ //yig brgya khro bcu bsdus pa bzhugs/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bsgrub thabs bsgom par 'dod pas/ thog mar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dkyil krung du bzhugs pa'i g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo/ g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub brkyang pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par a/ thugs khar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pas/ dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ ho gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ zag med kyi bde bas lus kyi rgyud gang*/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs/ zag med kyi bdud rtsi yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bab/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad khengs sdig sgrib dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa thams cad gshang gci'i lam dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badzra he ru ka te no pa tiṣṭa/ ḍi to me bha ba/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ a nu rag to me bha ba/ sarba si dhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsi taṃ shrī yang ku ru hūm̐/ haḥhaḥhaḥhaḥho/ bha ga ban sarba ta thā ga ta/ badzra he ru ka ma me muntsa badzra bha ba/ ma ha sa ma ya swa twa aḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces ci nus pa bzlas nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes brjod la rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// sna tshogs rdo rje/

de'i nang du paṃ las pad ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du bhrum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khong pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ lte ba dang rtsibs kyi bar na mu khyud bskor khang lta bu yod pa/ lte ba'i steng 'og dang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs kyi thad ka'i mu khyud kyi nang du sa gzhi la ma reg pa'i bar snang la/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig lte ba nyi ma'i steng du bhrum̐ ser po/ nyi ma gzhan rnams kyi steng du hūm̐/ de las khro bo bcu skad cig gis bskyed/ rims kyis gsal gdab/ dbus kyi lte bar gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon sdig mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen la brdzes pa/ spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ shar gyi rtsibs kyi thad so'i mu khyud kyi nang du/ gshin rje mthar byed sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje tho ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po g.yas be con/ nub tu pad ma mthar byed dmar po g.yas na pad ma/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po g.yas rdo rje/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po/ g.yas na ral gri/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po g.yas na lcags kyu/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa/ nub byang du stobs po che nag po g.yas na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad nag po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes ljang khu g.yas gtun shing 'dzin pa/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og gi khro bo rnams/ sku sbom zhing rags pa/ spyan dmar zhing bsgrad pa/ spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po/ rna ba la 'jog po dmar po/ mgul pa la pad ma chen po sngo skya/ dpung pa la rigs ldan khra bo/ lag 'khrigs la nor rgyas dkar po/ ske rags la dung skyong ser po/ se ral khar kar ka ta ljang nag rkang par padma sngo skya/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/

mtshams kyi khro bo rnams mdzes pa rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ hūm̐ mdzad ma gtogs pa rnams g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa'o// thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ de nas rang gi snying khar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang na bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs la/ oṃ argaṃ pra ti tstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe a hūm̐/ dhu pe/ ghan dhe/ oṃ badzra ne we te a hūm̐/ ces pas mchod/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de las snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta/ a bhi ṣin tsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i bum pa'i chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad yongs su gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gshin rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par bsam mo// de nas rang nyid gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de'i lte ba'i nang du/ nyi ma'i steng gi bar snang la/ rang gi rnam par shes pa hūm̐/ de'i steng du rang gi bla ma slob dpon/ g.yas su pha dang bu/ mdun du spun/ g.yon du ma dang chung ma/ rgyab la sogs par 'khor g.yog /'og tu nor rdzas la sogs pa bsam mo// gang mi bsrung ba stong par bzhag go /de nas hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad gtams par bsam/

gzhan rnams kyi'ang rang rang gi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus thams cad la rdo rje'i go bgos/ de nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi bar rnams su yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du dgra bgegs la sogs pa lus rid cing skra 'dzings pa/ spyi bo tshugs su 'dug pa kha nas khrag skyug pa bsam la/ de dag gi rnam par shes pa bkug la bstim/ de nas khro bo rnams zhal phyir bltas pa/ 'khor lo g.yon du myur du 'khor bas 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis dgra bgegs kyi lus phye mar gtubs/ de'i sdig sgrib dag nas mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes bar bsam zhing*/ na ma sa man ta bhu dha naṃ/ na ma sa man ta dharma naṃ/ na ma sa man ta paṃ ga nam̐/ oṃ si ta ta pa tre/ oṃ bhi ma la/ oṃ shang ka ra/ oṃ pa tyaṃ gi ra/ badzra u ṣṇi ṣa/ tsakra war ti/ sarba sna tra/ man tra/ mu la karma/ bhan dhan/ ta tra na/ ki la naṃ bha/ ma ma kri ti/ yāai na ke na/ tsidha kṛ tam̐ tad/ sarba du/ tshin dha tshin dha/ bhin dha bhin dha/ tsi ri tsi ri*/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci rigs par bzlas pa'i rjes la/ oṃ bha yang na sa ni/ tra sa ni/ tra sa ni/ sarba ma ra pra tyaṃ gi ra bhi na sa ni/ ye ke tsi dha/ duṣṭa sa ta ma ma bhi ru ba kyi/ ku ru pan ti ta ni/ sarba ni tra tyāṃ gi ra ni/ sa tu hūm̐ swāhā/ ces ci rigs par bzlas la/ gang dag su/ bla ma dam pa sku 'khor dang cas pa dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa sbyor ba rtsub par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad zhi bar gyur cig zhi bar ma gyur pa de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing par bgyi'o// ngag bcing par bgyi'o// mthu rlag par bgyi'o// rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig

des ma sgrub pa'i lha 'dre nyid kyi de'i sha la za bar gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis/ de nyid kyi mthu dang nus pa thams cad 'joms par gyur cig ces brjod cing thal mo brdab/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas brtan par bya'o// yig brgya dang khro bcu'i bzlas pa rang byung rdo rjes khyung rdzong du bris pa rdzogs so// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ dgyes pa rdo rje'i mchod khrigs bzhugs/// bla ma dang dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ sbyin bsregs la sogs pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o// rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ slob mas dur khrod ri'i bya skyibs la sogs pa/ rgyud las gsungs pa gang yang rung ba'i gnas su/ gong du brjod pa'i bya ba'am/ khyad par du tshogs kyi 'khor lo la ni/ tshogs kyi khang pa rim pa gsum pa phyag dar dang*/ legs par brgyan zhing yo byad 'tshogs par bya ste/ gzhung las gsungs pa'i gdan la thog mar rdo rje slob dpon 'khod nas/ 'du bar 'os pa rnams phyi rol du khrus byas te/ sgo bsrung ba mi g.yo ba'i rnam par byas pa la/ sgo dbye bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye/ khyod kyi dam tshig mdzes pa 'jam pa sngo mdog thugs// 'khor ba las rgal dpa' bo 'du ba'i tshogs mthong ngo*// rin chen bkod pa'i dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa kye// rnal 'byor ma rnams dbus su bdag mchi sgo dbyer gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ brda' dang*/ brda'-i lan dang ldan pas gral la 'khod de/ de nas las kyi rdo rje yis maṇḍal phul zhing phyag byas la/ yo gi sa ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes bya ba'am gang yang rung bas ting nge 'dzin la bskul nas/ bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i don du gtor ma btang zhing*/

bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar bltas la/ bla ma dag pa'i cho ga la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba bsgoms nas/ khyad par du ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i dus su/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pas khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pas// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi don slad du// bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// bcom ldan 'khos bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes rin chen 'bar ba'i rim pa las bshad pa 'di bya'o// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ 'dir ni dag tu bzhugs nas kyang*// brtse ba rjes su bzung ba dang*// byang chub sems ni rab 'phel phyir// brtan par 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// de ltar ye shes gzhug cing dbang bskur rdzogs nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs su/ dpal kri ṣṭa ba'i tshogs kyi cho ga las gsungs pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis thod pa bdud rtsi yis gang ba la/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyid po/ a las ka pa la/ hūm̐ bhrum̐ am̐ dzi lam̐ las grub pa'i bdud rtsi oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ a las zla ba/ hūm̐ las rdo rje phyed pa dang ldan pa bsgoms te/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ ha dmar po kha dog ngan pa sbyangs/ ho dkar po dri bsal/ ha ho hri oṃ ā hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi yang bkug nas/ bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis/ gru gsum bris pa la bdud rtsi gtor la zla ba'i gdan la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsams bdud rtsi 'theb srin gyis mchod cing rang gis kyang myang ngo*// de nas mchod pa'i skabs su rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab shing*/ hūm̐ gis bsangs la/ oṃ na ma sarba ta tha ga ta shri he ru ka sa pa ri wa ra dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho kham̐ ram̐/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ gong gi sngags la oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ kham̐ zhes zhabs bsil 'bul/ phyi'i mchod pa ni me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas la dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ na ma sarba ta tha ga ta shri he ru ka sa pa ri wa ra oṃ badzra puṣpe a hūm̐ swāhā// nags tshal las byung phan pa yi// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis las sogs 'gre'o// bzhes nas bdag oṃ na ma la sogs pa'i mthar// oṃ badzra dhu pe a hūm̐// srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gi= bzhes= oṃ badzra dhi baṃ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri// tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di// bdag gi= bzhes nas= oṃ badzra ghan dhe a hūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' dang bcas pa yi// kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bdag gi= bzhes nas= oṃ badzra ne wedye a hūm̐ swā hā// sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang*// cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs// bdag gi= bzhes nas= oṃ badzra shapta a hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes thub dka' zla ba'i cho ga las gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ hūm̐/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba ni// rnam snang mdzad kyis bzhes su gsol// sgra la rnam gsum shes byas te// lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan grags chen po// rdo rje sems dpa' bzhes su gsol// dri la rnam gsum shes byas te// lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya/ de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni// rin chen chen pos bzhes su gsol// ro la rnam gsum shes byas te// lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya/ de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid// rdo rje chos kyis bzhes su gsol// reg la rnam gsum shes byas te// lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// don yod bdag pos bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa/

shapta/ ghan dhe/ ra sa/ par she/ pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes gur las gsungs pa dang gzhan yang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ pi wang 'gying ba sngon mo ste// glu ma gling bu ser mo nyid/ bzhad ma rnga zlum dkar zhing dmar// bdug pa sngon mo me tog dkar// mar me dmar skya dri chab dkar// dri ma ro ma kha dog dmar/ reg bya me long ljang dang dkar// chos ma dkar zhing rang rtags can// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o// zhes de kho na nyid kyi bsgrub thabs su byung bas rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod par bya'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros nas/ ghi ri ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni dri chu lag /ghas sma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*// pu ka si ni dbus gnas bcud// ri khrod mas ni ro sna tshogs// gdol pa mos ni cang te'u brdung*// bde ba che po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// oṃ gha ri ghaṃ a hūm̐ swā hā/ tso ri tsaṃ/ bhe ta li bam̐/ gha sma ri gham̐/ pu ka si pam̐/ sha ba ri sham̐/ tsan dha li tsam̐/ ḍhoṃ bhi ni ḍaṃ/ a hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod do// spros pa la dga' na mchod pa gzhan nas gsungs pa rnams byas kyang 'gal ba med do// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye'i rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum po/ mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal// spyi bo dngas stengs nag po mdzes/ dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon// gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni// nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal// glang po rta bong glang rnga mong*// skyes pa khyi dang ma he can// g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/

nyi zla gshin rje gsang ba po// g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po// mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid// nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum// gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i// phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan// sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin// dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid// dam par dga' ba yang dag thob/ bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal// gham̐ las skyes pa'i gho ri mas// yan lag gnag cing g.yon pa nya// g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin// tshangs pa gnan la bdag phyag 'tshal// tsaṃ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma// btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su// phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams// dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal// baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo ni// ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan// phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yi// rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// gha sma ri ni byang gi sgor// ljang khu gham̐ las byung ba yi// phyag na sbrul dang thod pa 'brel// drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal// gshin rje mnan cing pam̐ las byung*// g.yon na dgra sta seng ge g.yas// dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma// phyag 'tshal pu ka si sngon la'o// ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung*// me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas// g.yon pa'i bsil byed g.yas pa na// dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsang ma// srin por tsaṃ las byung ba yi// g.yon na thong ba 'khor lo g.yas// phyag 'tshal srin po nyed pa la// dhaṃ las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni// rlung mtshams thag bzangs ris steng gshegs// phyag na sdig mdzub dang rdo rje// sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal// dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/

bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// bde ba ster 'di thams cad la// dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i// phyag 'tshal sa bon las byung ba'i// bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la// rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon// gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas// nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni// 'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan// nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i// bzhi po bde gsol rig ma bsdus byed pa'i// shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis// gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye rdo rje// lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas// bdag gi bsod nams gang thob pa// des ni 'jig rten bde mtshungs shog slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// kun tu sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong zhing*// sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba sdang bas gnod gzigs nas// zhe sdang kun tu zad bya'i phyir// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// bud med 'dul ba 'gro gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid 'gyur// phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin// sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba rmongs pas gzir gzigs nas// gti mug kun du zad mdzad pa// mgon po rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba khengs pas gzir gzigs nas// nga rgyal thams cad zad mdzad pa// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che// rdo rje dregs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba chags pas gzir gzigs nas/ chags pa thams cad zad mdzad pa// rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste// rdo rje chags la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba phrag dog gzir gzigs nas// thams cad kyi ni zad mdzad pa// rta bdun rgyal po chen po ste// thams cad gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/

'dod chags rdo rje bdag la gsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur// zhes gur las byung ba'i bstod pa rnams sam/ lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa/ a las skyes pa'i ne rig ma// nam mkha'i mdog can khro rgyal yum// spyan gsum mche ba rab tu gtsigs/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil// gri gug sdig mdzub bdud rnams sdig /ban dha'i rag ta yab la stob// sku smad stag gi sham thabs can// ni rang shu yis brgyan pa can// mi mgo skam po'i do shal can// gnyis med tshul gyis yab la 'khril// g.yon brkyang tshul gyis gar mdzad ma// dkyil 'khor thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// rnam rtog thams cad 'joms mdzad ma// bdag med yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// mos pa sna tshogs gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir// chos dbyings mi bskyod 'gag pa med pa la// thabs kyis sprul sku sna tshogs ston mdzad pa// ye shes thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid a las skyes// bdud bzhi zil gyis mnan pa 'jigs pa'i sku// mi bskyod bde ba chen po'i ngang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// a las skyes pa mdzes pa'i rdo rje ma// rtag tu dgyes pa kha ṭwāṃ ga la gzigs// gdug pa skrag mdzad rnam snang cod pan mtho// dur khrod rgyan dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// i las skyes pa'i gsang ba'i gho ri ma// gzi brjid mi mtshungs gar ldan ro mchog myong*// don dam thugs chud dbu rgyan rin chen tog /spyan gsum thod rlon can la phyag 'tshal lo// a li ka li'i snyoms 'jug rnal 'byor ma// bde bas rtag dgyes byang chub sems kyi ngang*// 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan i las skyes// gar gyis dgyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// u las skyes pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// khams gsum dag byed sgrol ma las kyi mchog/

don grub dbu rgyan chags pa spyan dang ldan// mtshungs med chags par ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med rnam dag chos dbyings pu ka si// mi bskyod dbu rgyan dri ma dag mdzad cing*// u las skyes pa rgya phyed phreng bar ldan// 'jig rten zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'dus ma byas kyi ri khrod ma// spros bral dri med rnam snang dbu la bzhugs// ri las byung ba gar gyi phyogs bcur gzigs// mchu zla dang mtshungs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs bgrod mdzad cing*/ 'du byed ma lus bsregs mdzad tsan dha li// rin chen dbu rgyan brjid pa ri las skyes/ 'dzag pa gsal mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i mtshan nyid las// thugs rje sprul mdzad yod pa'i dhoṃ bi ni// sgeg mo snang mtha' yas brgyan li las byung*// mkha' ltar dri med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu drag po rta yi skad sbyor zhing*// ro hi la dang a tra la dag dga'// zhes sdang rdo rje u rgyan lī las byung*// gho ri phyogs bcur gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid gsang ba'i yum gyur chom rkun ma// mi rtog mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i don la brtson// dbu rgyan gti mug rdo rje mi 'gyur rtags// e las skyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten ma lus chags pa dbang du bsdud// dpal dang gzi brjid bskyed mdzad bhe ta li// nga rgyal rdo rje dbu rgyan e las skyes// snyoms 'jug mi gnas ngang la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab thabs su ldan pa'i gha sma ri// de nyid la dgyes 'dod chags rdo rjes brgyan// oṃ las byung ba drag po'i las la dga'// skye med skye bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyu ma smig sgyu lta bu mkha' la spyod// bar snang mkha' la mnga' mdzad he ru'i ngang*// cod pan snang ba mtha' yas e las skyes// thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan sa 'og spyod// 'og gi 'jig rten ma lus bsgrol mdzad ma// aṃ las byung ba 'jigs pa'i dur khrod brgyan// thabs mkhas mthar thug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// a li ka li nyi zla kha sbyor sa bon rnam par dag pa las// gri gug thod pa la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rgyan mdzad cing*// dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar ldan gcer bu spyan gsum stag lpags sham thabs can// phyag rgya chen po'i sku la rtsa gsum sprul mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chen po dag las byung ba sku mnga' ye shes lnga ldan 'jigs gzugs can// bdag gis khyod kyi yon tan shas tsam mthong nas dad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa yis// khams gsum 'khor ba rgya mtshor gnas pa rnam rtog rlung gis phyogs bcur g.yengs ba rnams// skye rga na 'chi spangs nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal bla med byang chub thob par shog
gzhan yang gang rung rnams kyis bstod do//

bdag med ma'i bstod pa arya dhe bas mdzad pa'o// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams/ sngar ltar rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor bas byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs kyi phud dang dam tshig gi rdzas gtor mar blugs te/ gtor ma'i cho ga las gsungs pa lta bu'i gtor ma btang bar bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la bsod nams spel ba dang*/ las kyi rdo rje la sogs pas gnas gsum du dri'i thig le dang me tog la sogs pas kyang mchod par bya ste// de'i 'og tu thod pa dum bu cig pa bdud rtsis bkang nas/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin cig tu dgongs te rol// zhes brjod nas bla ma la drang ngo*// bla mas lag pa skor zhing g.yon pas bzed la g.yas pas rtse gsum par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam grol ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod la blang ngo*// de nas ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pas tshogs la longs spyad de/ de'i rim pa yang*/ ldom bhi he ru kas/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ chu gnas su ni raṃ las kyang*// 'bar ba'i khung du 'od 'bar bsam// de nas pam̐ las chu skyes brgyad// de steng lha'i dkyil 'khor bsam// kha ni hong khung rab bsams te// lag gnyis hūm̐ rdo rje yi// gzar bu gnyis su yang dag bsgom// rang rang so so'i lha ru bsam// rdo rje bzlas pa'i tshul gyis ni/ mi rtog sems kyi gsang sngags bzlas// nang gi rnal 'byor nges pa ni// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa'i// don dang ldan pas longs spyad par bya'o// de nas rjes kyi cho ga smon lam gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs phyag 'tshal lo// khyed la rab tu dad pa yis/ mchod pa'i tshogs ni rab phul bas// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs nas ni// bde chen rdo rje 'dzin rgyal shog

/rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ snyon med skye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma las gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag par rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// shes rab bde chen longs spyod par// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /zhes ldom bhi ba'i cho ga dang*/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i smon lam btab nas/ de nas tshogs kyi lhag ma las byas pa'i gtor ma bzang po bshams pa la/ chang gi kha phru btab nas/ oṃ bhyo bha ta li bha ra li bha ta la tshe zhes la/ lha mo zhal cig phyag bzhi pa bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa spyan drangs la/ oṃ bhyo bha ta la bhi ta li tshe/ dur khrod gnas mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo rtsigs byed yi dwags kha// dam tshig bsrungs ma khrag dga' mo// ki li sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru// rtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma// gsol cig bzhes cig dam tshig lha// gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis// bdag gi las 'di ci byed kyang*// de la kun gyis grogs gyis shig /zhes pas mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba can la gtor ma 'bul lo// gzhan yang*/ oṃ a ka ro mu kham̐/ sarba dharma naṃ/ adya nu pan na tya/ oṃ a hūm̐ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ u tshin dha bhin ddha sa ne bhya hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la yang bsngos te sbyin no// de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor yod na gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing*// ma tshangs pa dang lhag gyur dang*// gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa kun// de kun bzod par mdzad pa'i rigs// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang*// de yang khyed kyis bzod par mdzod// mnga' bdag nyid kyis gnang bar zhu/

yi ge brgya pa'i mthar oṃ badzra mu zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni// bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs bsgrubs shing*// dgyes pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ shes rab bdag med pad ma la ni rdo rje rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig pad ma dmar po ge sar tshul// 'dab brgyad la gnas lha mos zhal brgyad la phyogs shing*/ rol stabs sna tshogs kyis ni gtso bo mnyes par byed// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /rab dmar spyan gyis dus gsum gdul bya la gzigs shing*// nang stong la sogs bcu drug phyag gis dug gsum sel// bsdu dngos zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /log rtog bsal phyir dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar// sgeg pa la sogs ro dgu'i cha byad rab tu gsal// 'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /me long la sogs ye shes bzhi las grub pa'i sku// gho ri la sogs phyogs kyi pad ma la gnas pa// tshangs pa la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi las grub pa'i sku// pu ka si sogs mtshams kyi pad ma gnas pa// gshin rje la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po'i stobs rnams dang*// byang chub phyogs rnams sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gu mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod mchog gi bkod pa dang*// mu tig dra ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dri bu dpyangs// bden pa des kyang bden chen la gnas bkra shis shog

/rta babs pad ma 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub// mdzes pa'i ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs brkyangs pa/ rlung gis brjid pa'i dril bu dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod brgyad kyis legs bskor zhing*/ shir sha la sogs byang chub shing brgyad gnas pa la// glang chen gdong can la sogs brgyad po gnas pa yi// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog dpal ldom bhi zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i phyir/ bsngo ba gang yang rung ba bya'o// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa phyogs gcig bsdus byas te// nyams len rnams la phan phyir 'jug pa bde ba ru// lag khrigs 'di ni rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa yin// 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'byung bar gyur cig /bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog// / ༈ dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang chog bzhugs// bla ma dang dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum ye shes lnga rang bzhin// ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba sdom// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid// lha mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// lus sems dri ma sbyang ba dang*// lam gyi skal ba 'jog pa'i phyir// gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba'i// cho ga'i rim pa bshad par bya// bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la don rnam pa gsum ste/ gang gis bskur ba slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma dang*/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga'o// dang po ni gur las/ brtan zhing zab mo'i chos ldan dang*// rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas// sbyin bsregs dkyil 'khor sngags shes bya// rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son// de nyid bcu po'i rnam par rig

/nyan thos spyod pa skyong byed cing*// sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus// gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang*// dkyil 'khor bri mkhas bzlas par ldan// rtsa ba'i ltung bar rab 'joms shing*// sngags dang rgyud kyis rab sbyor gyis// 'jig rten rnams la bde ster ba/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pas// rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ slob ma ni/ bla ma la gus dbang po dul/ nga rgyal khro las rnam par grol// dge ba bcu la goms pa dang*// theg chen snying rje'i mchog gyur pa/ de lta bus lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab nas sbyin par bya'o// cho ga'i rim pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga dngos la gsum ste/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ tshom bu dgod cing mchod gtor bsham// lha mo bskyed cing mchod bstod bya// gsol gdab gshegs shing bya bas sbyang*// bdag gir bya ba dang po'o// dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag drug ldan du bsgoms te/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang nas/ maṇḍal byed pa'i sa der bdud rtsi'i chus thig le cig bya/ der me tog gi tshom bu cig bkram/ de la bam̐ las sa'i lha mo lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pa/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas pa kha len gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon pa rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bdag gis ci bgyi zer ba cig bskyed la/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang bas// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// 'gul do zhabs gdub sil sil can// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la// dkyil 'khor las rnam rab tu bsgrubs// hi hi hi hi bam̐ swāhā/

zhes pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes pas dam tshig sems dpa' la/ dgug gzhug cing mnyes pa'i las byas te/ sngon du mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod do// de nas/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kye'i rdo rje khros mchod pa'i// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// che ge bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba btab pas sa'i lha mo yis gnang ba byin par bsam ste/ gshegs su gsol zhing snying du thim par bsam mo// de nas sa brkos nas sa'i nyes skyon rnams dag par bsam la/ lag pa sa la bzhag cing nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag par bsam nas/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab cing*/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas sbyang bar bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gru gsum the bong gsum pa la sogs pa/ dbus mtho zhing mtha' babs kyis gzhol ba/ shar dang byang cung zad dma' bar byas te/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gtor zhing*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'dus rdo rje'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlab pa'o// nyi ma dang po'i bya ba'o// de nas bdag bskyed glus bskul zhing*/ bka' bsgo bgegs bskrad gar rnams bya/ ra ba gur bcas legs par bkod/ sa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'o// nub gnyis pa'i snga dro gnas nye bar brgyan la mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/ rdo rje slob dpon rus pa'i rgyan bgos shing dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug nas/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang zhing bskyed pa'i rims pa bsgoms te bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o// las byed pas phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa dang gtor ma ci rigs par byas nas/ shar phyogs nas gho ri'i nga rgyal gyis bskul ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog

/dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// yang lho phyogs nas/ mtshan rnams dam pas yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs// kun tu bzang po'i sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// yang nub phyogs nas/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyangs pa// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ yang byang phyogs nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol btab nas/ bdag nyid he ru ka zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par bsgyur/ rkang pa gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ mig gnyis su ma dang ta las nyi ma dang zla ba bsam la rab tu myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis lta zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su langs la rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje'i gom pas dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar gyi mtshams su song ste/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'o// rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis// lus gsum las skyes 'ges byas te// rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang 'da' ba// tshal par 'gems kyis gzhan du song*// bde chen ye shes rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes// lus srul po ni gang su dag /bgegs chen po rnams so sor song*// zhes brjod pa'i rjes la sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdzogs par bya ba dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bri yis/ gang su yang rung pas phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang 'byung po dang nam mkha' lding dang*/

mi'am ci dang rig 'dzin la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song cig /de ltar rdo rje 'dzin gyi bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba/ hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa/ ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun tu rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes pa dang*/ na ma sa man ta bu te bhyo/ na mo badzra kro ta ya/ ma ha dham̐ sha dhoṃ oṃ dha ka ta bhe ra sa ya badzra san to ha dar pa ya oṃ ā mṛ ta kun dha li hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i rjes la rtsa ba'i sngags kyang bzlas/ de ltar tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams lan gsum brjod/ de nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas/ g.yas nas brtsams te hūm̐ mang po brjod cing lan gsum bskor ba'o// de nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te/ he mang po brjod cing lan gsum bskor bar bya'o// yang na g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum po mnyam pa'i rkang stabs la sogs pa'i lta stangs drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gar gyis kun du bskor bar bya'o// de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bya'o// sa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa sta gon ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ lha dang bum pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// dang po ni tshom bu dgod cing mchod gtor bsham// legs bskyed dgug gzhug mchod bstod cing*// snyan gsan dbab cing nam mkhar bteg /dkyil 'khor lha'i sta gon no// de yang dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs te/ yab yum gang byed pa'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i dri yis thig le bya/ so so'i snying po brjod cing tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor/ mngon par rtogs pas bskyed la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bcing zhing mnyes par byas te/ phyi nang gyi mchod pa rnams 'bul/

bstod pa ci rigs pa bya/ bdud rtsi myang pa'ang byas nas/ spos lag tu thogs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can// ston pa'i khro bo khrag 'thung dpal// bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul ldan// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/
